severity_scale.CRITICAL: code is broken, exploitable, or violates an architectural invariant (Law Zero)

decisions_assumed.D1: Precedence: containerization-11 > orchestration-2 (only where multiple widgets) > TZ. TZ adapts on conflict.
decisions_assumed.D2: Dialogs are custom role=dialog overlays inside the container (v11 §2.3/§3.5), content styled with Bootstrap classes; inspector becomes a Bootstrap offcanvas driven through a data-ref element (no ids).
decisions_assumed.D3: One 1-word widget prefix "diagram" (keeps mandated names such as diagram-modal-overlay within the 3-word ceiling).
decisions_assumed.D4: Page orchestrator .diagram-page + ThemeController widget; data-bs-theme scoped on the orchestrator root; events via document.
decisions_assumed.D5: Form labels associated by wrapping the control in <label> (no ids), because v11 allows id only for ARIA/anchors.
decisions_assumed.D6: Import keeps accepting $entitymap 1.0.0; version field validated and migrated.
decisions_assumed.D7: Touch target 44 px as project requirement (WCAG 2.2 AA minimum is 24 px).
decisions_assumed.D8: Domain extensions (composite PK, self-relations) are candidates to stay out of scope.
